faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor post at PM SHRI Janpad Primary School Kolchur is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum and maximum age requirements for this position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor position. Age relaxation is applicable as per Chhattisgarh government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate Degree in Physical Education and a Graduate Degree in a Yoga Education related field to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 10000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will the candidates be selected for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a merit list prepared from the marks obtained and relevant experience. Document verification will also be conducted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Bastar district, which is https://bastar.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The recruitment is for a contractual position as a Yoga/Sports Teacher/Instructor at PM SHRI Janpad Primary School Kolchur.
